title: Bug memory
description: One bug, as `.ai/bugs/BUG-NNN-<slug>.md` or as an inline entity block. `symptoms` is required for every bug, because a bug with no symptom is a bug nobody can recognise again. `root_cause` is required before `status: fixed`: the whole value of bug memory is the reason the fix works, and a fix recorded without it is a guess that will be re-made.

symptoms.description: What was observed: the error, the wrong output, the command that produced it.

root_cause.description: Why it happened. Required before the status reaches `fixed`.

prevention.description: The test, check, or rule that stops this class of bug returning.
